title: Incident management
subtitle: Built around the team.
description: A custom incident management system connecting Slack workflows, AI-assisted triage, on-call coordination and RCA documentation.
summary: Ready-made tools didn’t match how our support, customer success, engineering and delivery teams worked together. I designed, developed and rolled out a custom incident management system.

card.title: Incident management built around the team
card.summary: The team needed an incident process that matched how people actually worked together. I designed, built and rolled out a custom system connecting reporting, AI-assisted investigation, on-call coordination and follow-up.

flow.eyebrow: How a request moves through the process
flow.title: From a report to the right response.

triage.title: Clarify & investigate
triage.text: AI prepares context; people assess the next step.

steps.title: Resolve in Slack
steps.text: Clarify the question or resolve the issue without incident escalation.
steps.label: Resolution shared with the team

steps.title: Escalate to an incident
steps.text: The on-call engineer decides when incident coordination is needed.
steps.label: Coordination · RCA draft · team review

flow.footnote: The on-call engineer makes the escalation decision; the team reviews the RCA draft.

startingPoint.text: The goal was to keep Slack as the shared place where teams could discuss issues and questions, follow progress and see the outcome.

items.title: Support questions as well as incidents
items.text: I built separate paths for questions, clarification and investigation, so a report can be resolved without triggering full incident coordination.
items.supporting: AI-assisted triage draws on tracking systems and logs to prepare context for the responder.

items.title: Keep responsibility aligned
items.text: I connected the calendar, Slack and Instatus so on-call assignments stay aligned through shift changes and temporary cover.

items.title: Carry context into follow-up
items.text: The system turns the incident conversation and its threads into a root cause analysis (RCA) draft in Confluence, then returns the link to Slack for the team to verify and complete.

outcome.text: The system is in use by the team. Teams discuss issues and questions in Slack, follow progress and see the outcome, with links to the resulting analysis.

technical.title: Technical details
technical.text: The workflow app uses the Deno Slack SDK. Scheduled synchronization keeps on-call assignments aligned; webhooks connect external monitoring services to the response process.
technical.stack: Deno Slack SDK · Calendar integration · Instatus · Confluence
